channel.title: ALTRENDAT
channel.description: What the world is searching for, explained with sources

item.title: Alexandra Eala storms into WTA 250 Hong Kong Open quarterfinals after victory
item.description: Filipino second seed Alexandra Eala defeated Tereza Valentova in two sets on Thursday to secure her spot in the tournament quarterfinals.

item.title: Severe Thunderstorms Dump Up To 40mm Of Rain Per Hour In Northland
item.description: MetService issued a severe thunderstorm watch for Northland, Auckland, Waikato, Bay of Plenty and Taranaki as a tropical airmass brings unstable conditions today.

item.title: Elon Musk Wealth Plunges $90 Billion Following Major Midterm Election Losses
item.description: Elon Musk's net worth has dropped below $800 billion after shares of Tesla and SpaceX plummeted following the midterm elections.

item.title: South Africa braces for level 4 storm alerts as severe weather strikes
item.description: The South African Weather Service issued level 4 and level 2 thunderstorm warnings for multiple provinces, bringing threats of heavy rain and flooding.

item.title: Lenny Joseph brace stuns San Siro as Ferencvaros downs AC Milan 2-0
item.description: AC Milan suffered a damaging 2-0 defeat to Ferencvaros on Thursday, leaving the Italian side with three losses in their opening four Europa League matches.

item.title: Celtic clinches first Europa League victory after hard-fought comeback against Besiktas
item.description: Celtic secured their first win of the Europa League campaign after rallying to defeat Besiktas.

item.title: IRS Raises Income Thresholds for 2027 Tax Brackets to Combat Bracket Creep
item.description: The IRS has increased federal income tax brackets and standard deductions for 2027 to account for inflation, helping taxpayers avoid higher tax rates.

item.title: Brighton storms into Madrid seeking European glory against struggling Getafe side
item.description: Brighton faces Getafe on matchday three of the Conference League following a strong start to their domestic campaign.

item.title: Sparta Prague topples Bournemouth as 10-man side holds onto narrow lead
item.description: Sparta Prague secured a 1-0 UEFA Europa League victory over Bournemouth after Ebrima Singhateh scored following a fast break.

item.title: Semiconductor Rout Deepens as Nasdaq Plunges 3.8% Amid Fading Midterm Rally
item.description: The S&P 500 fell 2.1% and the Nasdaq dropped 3.8% on Thursday as a sell-off in chip stocks countered the gains from the post-election surge.

item.title: Chip Stocks Slip as Democrats Gain Congress Control Amid Market Relief Rally
item.description: Shares of semiconductor companies, including Nvidia and Micron, fell on Wednesday as markets reacted to a Democratic sweep of both congressional chambers.

item.title: 18 Commercial Flights Across Europe Diverted Following String of Malicious Bomb Threats
item.description: At least 18 flights across Europe faced security disruptions on Thursday due to a series of unconfirmed bomb threats reported to multiple airlines.

item.title: World Number 19 Alexandra Eala Storms Into Prudential Hong Kong Open Draw
item.description: Filipino tennis star Alexandra Eala faces American Alycia Parks in the first round of the WTA 250 tournament at Victoria Park Tennis Stadium this Tuesday.

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo Retires From Portugal Duty After 234 Caps and 146 Goals
item.description: The 41-year-old forward has officially announced his retirement from international football, concluding a career that began in 2003.

item.title: Catastrophic Flash Flood Warning Forces McCaysville Shutdown as Waters Rise Across Georgia
item.description: The National Weather Service issued a catastrophic flash flood warning for north Georgia, triggering a state of emergency and bridge closures in McCaysville.

item.title: Digital MySSS Cards and Member Services Surge Into eGovPH Superapp Platform
item.description: The Social Security System is integrating its digital ID and member services into the eGovPH superapp following a partnership agreement with the DICT.

item.title: Democrats Clinch Senate Majority Flipping Seats In Republican Strongholds For 54 Seats
item.description: Democrats secured a 54 to 44 majority in the Senate and gained 30 House seats in a midterm victory that challenges President Donald Trump.

item.title: Powerball Jackpot Hits $847 Million With Winning Numbers Drawn This Wednesday
item.description: The winning numbers for Wednesday's $847 million Powerball jackpot are 15, 34, 41, 53, 56, and the Powerball is 21.

item.title: Penrose inferno hospitalizes three and triggers widespread power outages across Auckland
item.description: A massive building fire in Penrose has sent three people to the hospital while causing significant power outages and traffic disruptions.

item.title: Capital Jingle Bell Ball 2026 tickets go on sale this November
item.description: Capital Plus subscribers and Barclaycard holders gain early access to Jingle Bell Ball tickets starting November 5th, with a general sale following on November 6th.

item.title: Manchester United Overcomes Two-Goal Deficit to Clinch Thrilling 3-2 Champions League Victory
item.description: Manchester United completed a dramatic second-half comeback to defeat Roma 3-2 at Old Trafford in the Champions League.

item.title: Arsenal storms into Prague for Champions League clash against Slavia Prague
item.description: Arsenal plays an away Champions League fixture against Slavia Prague today with the English side expected to win.

item.title: Manchester City looks to snap three-match winless streak against perfect RB Leipzig
item.description: Manchester City travels to face RB Leipzig, who remains unbeaten at home this season without conceding a single goal.

item.title: Undefeated Real Betis storms Signal Iduna Park to challenge Borussia Dortmund
item.description: Borussia Dortmund hosts an undefeated Real Betis side on Wednesday evening for a crucial UEFA Champions League group stage encounter.

item.title: Eagles Promote Joe Milton to Starting Quarterback Role Against New York Giants
item.description: Joe Milton takes over as the Philadelphia Eagles' starting quarterback for this Sunday's game against the New York Giants.

item.title: Andoni Iraola hands five changes to Liverpool line-up for Fenerbahce clash
item.description: Liverpool faces Fenerbahce in Istanbul tonight for a UEFA Champions League league-phase fixture.

item.title: Real Madrid Storms Greece Seeking Seventh Straight Win Against Struggling AEK Athens
item.description: Real Madrid faces AEK Athens at the ALLWYN Arena this Wednesday, aiming to maintain their flawless Champions League record.

item.title: Kellogg’s Admits Rice Krispies Snap, Crackle and Pop is Quieter After Reformulation
item.description: Kellogg's replaced whole rice grains with corn and rice flour in UK Rice Krispies and Coco Pops, resulting in a noticeably quieter sound.

item.title: Dublin institution Bunsen Burger claims second spot in global burger rankings
item.description: Travel blog Big 7 ranked Dublin-based Bunsen Burger as the second-best burger joint in the world.

item.title: Real Madrid reach verbal agreement to snatch Manchester United teenager JJ Gabriel
item.description: Real Madrid expects to sign 16-year-old forward JJ Gabriel in January after the player walked out on Manchester United in September.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh Braces for Heavy Rain as Depression Approaches Bay of Bengal
item.description: The India Meteorological Department expects three days of moderate rain across south coastal Andhra Pradesh as a weather system develops over the Bay of Bengal.

item.title: Power outage at London studio forces ITV to pull live morning shows
item.description: ITV cancelled live broadcasts of Lorraine, This Morning, and Loose Women on Wednesday, November 4, following an overnight power cut at the Covent Garden studio.

item.title: Mid-Michigan voters head to polls for crucial statewide races and local proposals
item.description: Voters in mid-Michigan cast their ballots on Tuesday, Nov. 3, to decide on various statewide races and local bond and millage proposals.

item.title: Virat Kohli Smashes Cricket History With 13,000 ODI Runs at No. 3
item.description: Virat Kohli became the first batter to reach 13,000 ODI runs at the number three position during the opening match of India's tour of New Zealand.

item.title: Academy Graduate Senny Mayulu Starts As PSG Storms Villarreal For Champions League
item.description: Paris Saint-Germain faces Villarreal this Tuesday for matchday four of the Champions League league phase.

item.title: Stuttgart backtracks after mocking Galatasaray’s stadium sound system before Champions League clash
item.description: VfB Stuttgart apologized to Galatasaray after a deleted social media post questioning the authenticity of the atmosphere at Rams-Park.

item.title: Ravens sign Kedon Slovis to bolster quarterback room after multiple injury hits
item.description: The Baltimore Ravens are signing 25-year-old quarterback Kedon Slovis from the Green Bay Packers practice squad to address a depleted roster.

item.title: Democrats Target Eight Key Senate Seats to Topple Current Republican Majority
item.description: Control of the U.S. Senate rests on 35 seats contested in the 2026 midterms, with eight races remaining uncalled by experts.

item.title: Americans head to polls in referendum on Trump's second term agenda
item.description: Voters across the United States are casting ballots today to determine which party controls Congress for the remainder of Donald Trump's presidency.

item.title: Ginebra eyes series sweep to topple San Miguel in PBA quarterfinals showdown
item.description: Barangay Ginebra attempts to eliminate San Miguel Beer in tonight’s Game 3 of their PBA Season 50 Governors’ Cup quarterfinals.
